definition: The task of converting spoken audio into written text, also known as automatic speech recognition.
details: Speech-to-text systems power applications like voice assistants, transcription services, and captioning, with modern systems built on large neural sequence models trained on extensive labeled audio data.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Speech-to-Text — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
